title: ArtifactIndexItem
description: A single entry in the KeepMees artifact index (docs/ops/artifact-index.md)

path.description: Relative file path from repo root (e.g. src/products/product-catalog.js)

exports.description: KMEngine namespace exports from this module (if applicable)

purpose.description: What this file does or represents

scopeGuarded.description: True if this file or items within it are under the scope guard (do not touch without authorization)

scopeGuardItems.description: Specific constants or constructs within this file that are scope-guarded

testCount.description: Number of tests in this file (for test artifacts)

package.description: Package that created or last materially updated this artifact
